ЮНЕСКО: число погибших в зонах конфликтов журналистов выросло на 24% за два года
В зонах конфликтов в мире за 2024-2025 годы погибли 189 журналистов — на 24% больше, чем за предыдущие два года. Это также самый высокий показатель с 2014-2015 годов, следует из доклада ЮНЕСКО.
Большая часть сотрудников СМИ (40%), погибших в зоне боевых действий, стали жертвами ударов беспилотников, указано в материалах организации. Как минимум 62 журналиста убиты в Палестине, 17 — в Мексике, 14 — в Судане. Еще 12 погибли на Украине, двое — в России.

links.summary: As France confronts another wave of strikes and protests, Gaëlle Martinez, National Secretary of the trade union Solidaires, presents the general strike as more than a confrontation over wages, public spending or the cost of living. Her account reveals a deeper struggle over economic dignity, the future of public services and the democratic right to collective protest. “People just want to live, not survive.” For Martinez, deteriorating schools, insufficient salaries and the dismantling of public services are not isolated policy failures. They are interconnected symptoms of political and economic priorities that, in her assessment, place fiscal restraint above social welfare. Her demand for “a new budget” that is “not based on cuts” is accompanied by a call to “tax the biggest companies, the richest companies where the profits are made.”

links.summary: Like a tag team of oiled snakes that have entered a wrestling contest, theme is a difficult quality to pin down. A game can be well designed, but if it lacks a coherence between those mechanics and its appearance, narrative, and its framing, there is a dissonance that can be hard to ignore. I realise I've just stepped into an old argument by using the word 'dissonance' , but Hocking was right, games that don't cohere can be jarring. A developer may desire that sensation of discomfort, but often it is accidental and unwanted. (Much like opening an article with a simile about wrestling snakes when there is nothing connecting that image to a game about solitaire. It might be a good line, but it doesn't smoothly connect with the rest of the article to elevate its argument.) Anyway, what does this all have to do with Forbidden Solitaire , a game in which you're delving deeper into a dungeon filled with horrors, progressing by clearing screens of cards? Well, it's an excellent example of how

links.summary: Catherine Viette is pleased to welcome Jens Schumacher, Field Coordinator in Mykolaiv and Kherson with Solidarity International. Just a few kilometers separate the Ukrainian-controlled city of Kherson from Russian-occupied Oleshky. For civilians caught between military occupation, disrupted essential services and uncertain evacuation arrangements, geographical proximity offers little guarantee of access to life-saving assistance. Schumacher examines the humanitarian implications of a temporary ceasefire around Oleshky, where approximately 2,000 civilians were reported to remain. Although the cessation of attacks has created a limited opportunity for humanitarian operations, the geographical scope of the agreement, the prospects for evacuation and the possibility of sustained humanitarian access remain uncertain.

links.summary: Chelsea must have known their fate as soon as the last 16 tie at Anfield went to penalties. Four times they had faced Liverpool in a penalty shoot-out previously and four times they had lost. Make that five, after Wesley Fofana’s woeful attempt sailed high into the Kop and sent Andoni Iraola’s side into the Carabao Cup quarter finals. The defender was not the only culprit as Chelsea’s catalogue of penalty misery against Liverpool gained a new chapter to add to the 2007 Champions League semi final, the 2019 Uefa Super Cup final and the FA and League Cup finals of 2022. Emmanuel Emegha could have won it for Xabi Alonso’s visitors but his effort was saved superbly by Giorgi Mamardashvili.

links.summary: Bets predicted exact top-five men’s finishing order Organisers France Football have contacted police A series of suspicious bets that correctly predicted the exact top-five finishing order of this year’s Ballon d’Or and generated almost $200,000 (£149,000) in winnings is being investigated by the event’s organisers, France Football, who have also contacted the police. It has been alleged that 12 Polymarket accounts – an American cryptocurrency-based prediction market – placed the bets, with more than $264,000 wagered on the outcome before Monday’s ceremony. Their extraordinary accuracy has raised serious questions about a potential leak of confidential results before football’s most prestigious individual award. Harry Kane was crowned the winner at the ceremony at the London Palladium, finishing ahead of Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal, Rodri and Lionel Messi. Remarkably, this was the exact order predicted by the group of accounts identified in French media outlet Upside’s investigation .
links.title: Suspicious bets returning £149,000 for predicting Ballon d’Or under investigation

В МАГАТЭ сообщили о гибели сотрудника Запорожской АЭС при ударе БПЛА
Сотрудник Запорожской атомной электростанции (ЗАЭС) погиб из-за удара беспилотника. Об этом сообщила пресс-служба Международного агентства по атомной энергии (МАГАТЭ).
Погибший был сварщиком в централизованной ремонтной мастерской станции, уточнили в агентстве. Генеральный секретарь организации Рафаэль Гросси осудил атаку. Он заявил, что любые удары, приводящие к гибели или ранению сотрудников, нарушают основы ядерной безопасности во время вооруженного конфликта.

links.summary: A heavy police presence was hard to miss on the streets of Paris on Saturday, as the capital saw demonstrations for a third consecutive weekend over the rising cost of living and deteriorating conditions in schools. But the increased security failed to prevent clashes in several parts of the city. Riot police fired tear gas to push back protesters, while small fires broke out in several areas. Similar scenes unfolded across the country, including in Bordeaux, Toulouse and Marseille. Still, the demonstrations were largely less violent than the chaos witnessed on October 17. Caroline Baum has this round-up of the day's events.

links.summary: Pool A: Jillaroos 124-6 Wales Jaime Chapman scores six tries in record-breaking win The record-breaking Jillaroos have warmed up for the challenge of the World Cup semi-finals with a destruction of Wales that highlights the gulf between rugby league haves and have nots. The 124-6 victory sets a new women’s World Cup record score and winning margin, eclipsing the 92-0 win recorded by Australia over France in 2022. The Jillaroos even went past the men’s tournament record – set by the Kangaroos in a 110–4 humbling of Russia in 2000 – even though the duration of the women’s game is 10 minutes fewer than the men’s. Their 124 points was also the highest score recorded in an international rugby league match.

2d442c6f315fd8cd192e.lead_ru:
Житель Брянской области не выжил в результате подрыва на взрывном устройстве Вооруженных сил Украины (ВСУ). Об этом сообщил губернатор региона Егор Ковальчук.
48-летний россиянин подорвался на взрывном устройстве в лесу рядом с деревней Бабинка Карачевского района. Ковальчук предупредил жителей, что походы в лесистую местность потенциально опасны.
«️Откажитесь от походов в лес в районах, прилегающих к зоне проведения специальной военной операции, и там, где действуют официальные ограничения на посещение лесов», — настоял Ковальчук.
Ранее стало известно, что ВСУ начали подвешивать дроны на проводах ЛЭП вдоль дорог.

links.summary: Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure. The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party. However, polls showed it getting less than a third of the vote, down from 45.6% at the last municipal elections in 2021 and 40.2% in 2024’s national elections .

Согласно местным сообщениям, нападения произошли в четверг в провинции Афьонкарахисар, где жертвы были найдены в нескольких местах в трех отдельных транспортных средствах. На кадрах видеонаблюдения, опубликованных в турецких СМИ, видно, как мужчина в черной куртке, белых брюках и очках сжимает длинное оружие, стоя у красного минивэна.

links.summary: Updates from the final match of the series at Newlands First ball in Cape Town is 10.30am local/7.30pm AEDT/8.30am GMT Any thoughts? Get in touch with an email One, two, three. That’s as many Tests as we’re going to get in this series, and today begins the third and final. It’s the one that we’ve all been waiting for: the return to Cape Town, the scene of all that went wrong for Australia in 2018, and thus the location with so much riding on it should they put on a performance that would create some fresher and better memories. That, though, would require a serious turnaround in form and fortune, given the way South Africa slowly stomped them last week in Gqeberha. Australia’s batting is the weak point, given their win in Durban was largely carried on the capacious shell of The Turtle, Matthew Renshaw, while their loss the following week was down to their insipid 99 all out in their first attempt with the bat.

links.summary: Decision to bowl first looked like backfiring But hosts all out for 329 after being 140-0 at lunch For a time, it was heading up there with the worst. David Gower at Leeds in 1989, when Australia topped 600 and declared. Nasser Hussain in Brisbane, 2002, when Australia were 364 for 2 by the end of the day. Edgbaston 2005, where England lamped 407 from 80 overs. Those were the looming comparisons for captains deciding to bowl at the toss, after Pat Cummins did the same in the third Test at Cape Town, only for South Africa’s openers to smash 140 by lunch. Yet, by day’s end, Australia had taken 10 for a further 189, Mitchell Starc destroying the tail with four wickets in six balls, all out 329 constituting a serious Australian comeback. What a rollercoaster. The Australian setup has looked frazzled this tour: confused player selections for the squad, then for the XIs, confused shot selection in the middle, players bouncing around the order with nightwatch duties and injury absences. It twisted, it turned, it rocked, it rolled, and it had Double Richard umpiring duties in the middle for Dick Kettleborough’s 100th Test. We can at least guarantee the continuation of the umpiring part, barring any more illness absences like the one that took out Chris Gaffaney in the previous match. Australia ended the day happier, after Mitch Starc’s absurd ending burst of 6 for 10, and South Africa started it happier, after Aiden Markram and Marques Ackerman flayed everything in the first session. If he is back to anything resembling his best, then the Proteas could soon be right back in this Test. links.summary: Star Wars has been back in the news recently because, to cut a long story short, the US alt-right have decided that Darth Vader was actually the good guy . We are not here to indulge such buffoonery. We are here to talk about Fate of the Galaxy, a free unofficial space combat simulator set during the events of the original Star Wars trilogy, featuring several mission-based campaigns and a stable of Imperial and Rebel Alliance ships that ranges from the quad-blasting X-Wing to Boba Fett's Firespray 31. Also, Naboo starfighters, if you really must. It's a total conversion of poor dead Volition 's venerable dogfighter FreeSpace 2, running on the open source Free Space 2 Open engine via the popular Knossos launcher . You don't need a copy of FreeSpace 2 to play it. You also don't need to pay. And nor do you need a whizbang PC – this bucket of bolts hums along happily on my i5-1145G7 with no dedicated graphics card. As the Rancor said to the padawan: finally, some good food.

NASA завершило операцию «Большой взрыв» (Big Bang), которая позволит зонду «Вояджер-1» (Voyager 1) на годы продлить научную работу в межзвёздном пространстве.

Процедура заключалась в переключении с одних нагревателей на другие, что позволило высвободить 10 Вт энергии.

Но операция могла закончиться плохо: вскоре зонд на двое суток перешёл в безопасный режим и не отвечал на команды с Земли.

Источник изображений: NASA
Процедура была проведена в сентябре 2026 года — через восемь недель, после аналогичной перенастройки бортовых систем зонда «Вояджер-2».

Катастрофа в Испании снизила шансы Педро Санчеса на переизбрание
Трагедия в Испании, где в столкновении двух поездов 28 октября погибли десятки человек, случилась в самое неподходящее для испанских властей время.

Ровно через месяц в стране пройдут парламентские выборы, на которых шансы премьера-социалиста Педро Санчеса на переизбрание и так выглядели довольно скромно.

В последние недели он начал укреплять свои позиции в противостоянии с главным соперником — лидером консервативной Народной партии Альберто Нуньесом Фейхоо.

links.summary: Bristol 16-22 Leicester Visitors score four tries in error-strewn game In the end there was a relatively clear winner of this straight shootout for top spot in the Prem. Leicester took the spoils in a error-strewn contest between two sides who began the night in second and third position, scoring four tries to one and being masterfully steered to a bonus-point victory by their alert fly-half Billy Searle, whose left boot set up three tries in addition to landing two conversions. Following on from their commanding second-half display in the wet at home to Northampton last Saturday, the Tigers were far from perfect but had the game’s outstanding player in Searle, whose left boot set up all three of his side’s tries in addition to landing the goals. Bristol, reduced to 13 players in the second quarter by a brace of yellow cards, had their moments but ultimately coughed up possession far too often.

links.summary: Italian 20-year-old is on the verge of becoming the youngest world champion with the Mexican Grand Prix ready for a carnival coronation atmosphere An undeniable highlight of this Formula One season, marked by discontent at the new regulations, has been getting swept along by the sheer joy that the world champion-in-waiting, Kimi Antonelli, has displayed on his way to a title he will almost surely secure this weekend at the Mexican Grand Prix. Antonelli was still a teenager for the first half of the year and it seemed fitting to describe him as such. His exuberant embrace of competing for Mercedes at the sharp end of F1 in just his second season was that of any 19-year-old. Like discovering a life-changing new band or how much fun can be had with a cold beer, a wide grin was barely off his face.
links.title: Fiesta awaits in Mexico City as Kimi Antonelli speeds towards F1 history

Папа Лев принимает Боба Дилана в официальной резиденции в Риме - Папа Лев XIV принимал Боба Дилана в своей официальной резиденции, Апостольском дворце, в среду во время остановки в Риме во время итальянского тура певца и автора песен. 85-летний Дилан носил почти полностью черный наряд, в том числе натянутую толстовку с капюшоном, перчатки и зонт, резко контрастируя с полностью белым одеянием Папы Римского, родившегося в Чикаго.
По сообщению Vatican News, встреча между парой, ВОЗ , оба родом со Среднего Запада США, была короткой. Лев подарил нобелевскому лауреату розарий, а Дилан подарил Лео копию своей автобиографии «Хроники: том первый».

And now, the laws of political gravity may finally be catching up with Donald Trump's hyper-aggressive exercise of executive authority. Захватывающе для поклонников старой школы Guild Wars, Afterlife, кажется, возвращает некоторый контент из давно отмененной кампании Utopia, включая мистическую, вдохновленную Мезоамерикой обстановку Xotecha. Новое дополнение перенесет игроков с континента Тирия в Туман, чтобы исследовать затерянные земли мертвецов.

links.summary: Another European away day, another victory for Arsenal: albeit only just. This time, Viktor Gyökeres stole the show as poor Slavia Prague matched the longest winless streak in European Cup and Champions League history despite a spirited late comeback. That unwanted record stands at 23, equalling the mark set by AEK Athens and FCSB – formerly known as Steaua Bucharest – while Arsenal are unbeaten in their 10 last away trips. However, had it not been for a wonder save from David Raya, the Czech champions would have snatched a point after Wiktor Nowak pulled one back late on as Mikel Arteta’s usually watertight defence showed signs of fallibility under pressure.

Поиск Германией места для захоронения ядерных отходов 1 ноября 2026 года Вряд ли какая-либо экологическая и политическая проблема является такой же сложной, как захоронение радиоактивных отходов с атомных электростанций. Работающие страны — около 31 страны в настоящее время эксплуатируют или когда-то эксплуатировали атомные электростанции — этот вопрос остается в значительной степени нерешенным, несмотря на то, что первая крупномасштабная атомная электростанция была введена в эксплуатацию в Советском Союзе в 1954 году.
Финляндия недавно стала первой страной в мире, одобрившей создание хранилища радиоактивных ядерных отходов.

links.summary: George Russell second on grid after qualifying Antonelli well placed as he nears title confirmation Even as Formula One’s young gun Kimi Antonelli remains on course to claim his first world championship on Sunday it was the veteran, seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton who gave a salutary reminder that there is very much fight left in the old dog yet as he claimed a spectacular pole position for the Mexico City Grand Prix. Hamilton delivered a superb lap for Ferrari to secure his first pole for the team and just beat Mercedes’ George Russell into second. World champion in waiting Antonelli was in fourth place but remains in position to close out the title on Sunday, although Hamilton and Russell, who must win the race to have any hope of keeping the fight alive, have at least locked out the front row.

7716d80344c0dbf739de.lead_ru:
Почему США, Россия и Китай спешат разместить ядерные реакторы на Луне? Лунные реакторы могут произвести революцию в освоении Луны, обеспечивая энергию для баз и добычи полезных ископаемых, но риски загрязнения остаются. Соединенные Штаты, Россия и Китай спешат построить ядерные реакторы на Луне, поскольку ученые предупреждают о возможном риске радиоактивного несчастного случая.
В январе космическое агентство США NASA объявило о планах разработать ядерный реактор на Луне к концу 2030 года. Россия, работая с Китаем, стремится сделать то же самое к 2036 году, поскольку они стремятся продвигать освоение космоса.

links.summary: In Saint-Malo, in France's Brittany region, the legendary Route du Rhum is preparing to set sail. It's a high-speed, high-risk crossing that takes place every four years.

links.summary: The 115 sailors competing in the Route du Rhum set sail from Saint-Malo on Sunday in mild weather, embarking on a solo transatlantic crossing. The race began at 12:02 GMT, with boats heading along the Brittany coast in light winds towards a mandatory checkpoint near Cap Fréhel, where crowds had gathered to watch. One competitor, Nicolas d’Estais, described the conditions as ideal before boarding his yacht, Café Joyeux. Selina Sykes reports from Saint-Malo.

links.summary: После самого резкого падения акций с семидесятых годов прошлого века, вызванного ухудшением прогнозов по рынку ПК, проблемы Intel усугубились. Ей срочно требуется наладить работу своего проблемного подразделения по контрактному производству полупроводников. Задача до сих пор продолжается труднодостижимой. Значительную часть своих капитальных вложений, которые составили $108 млрд за минувшие пять лет, Intel истратила на попытки составить конкуренцию TSMC. Но у неё так и нет ни одного крупного стороннего заказчика на производство передовых чипов — компания по-прежнему выпускает полупроводники преимущественно для собственных нужд.

links.summary: The clue, of course, is right there in the title. Developer Freshly Baked Games' Queen's Domain isn't just a retro-fantasy action RPG played in first-person; it's an explicit homage to King's Field, the long-dormant FromSoftware series that - as the precursor to Demon's Souls, Dark Souls, Bloodborne, Sekiro, Elden Ring , and all those other Souslikes - helped shape the modern gaming landscape in its own small way. That, though, is pretty much where my knowledge of the series begins and ends - as much as I love FromSoftware, I've never actually played a King's Field game. I've no idea how Queen's Domain shapes up as Kings Field-like, then, but I do know that, five or so hours in, it's already shaping up to be one of my favourite games this year.
links.title: Before Dark Souls there was King's Field, and five hours into brilliant homage Queen's Domain, it's already one of my favourite games this year

880c8ce38ee0ef777991.lead_ru:
Electronic Arts недавно полностью убила Mass Effect и закрыла разработчика BioWare , но издатель все еще пытается заработать на поклонниках франшизы. В преддверии ежегодного праздника Mass Effect N7 Day 7 ноября EA продвигает Mass Effect через посты о том, что фанаты могут купить в магазине передач BioWare . Многие люди в Интернете говорят, что это глухота и грубое поведение.
Присутствие BioWare Gear Store в социальных сетях возродилось сегодня после месяца темноты, чтобы начать торговать товарами Mass Effect.

links.summary: Electronic Arts recently killed off Mass Effect and closed developer BioWare entirely, but the publisher is still trying to make money from the franchise's fanbase. Ahead of the annual Mass Effect holiday of N7 Day on November 7, EA is promoting Mass Effect via posts about what fans can buy on the BioWare Gear Store. A lot of people online are saying this is tone deaf and gross behavior. The BioWare Gear Store's social media presence came back to life after a month of darkness today to start hawking Mass Effect merch. The post that kicked things off is the one below, in which fans are invited to "celebrate the legacy" of Mass Effect by giving EA money. EA followed the post up with eight more, pushing people to visit the BioWare Gear Store to buy things like mugs, tote bags, clothing, and shoes, among other things. https://twitter.com/BioWareGear/status/2118417071415476477 The replies under every one of the posts call out how cold and gross it is to promote the brand so soon after cance
links.title: EA Killed Mass Effect But Is Still Trying To Make Money On It
links.title_ru: EA убила Mass Effect, но все еще пытается заработать на этом

Antonelli secured his first world title in Mexico City on Sunday, at 20 years old becoming the ­youngest F1 champion in only his second season in the sport. links.summary: “You can be as repressive as you want. The grievances are still here.” With this stark observation, Ariane Bogain, lecturer in French and politics at Northumbria University, captures the central dilemma confronting the French government: how can political authority be restored when the social and economic grievances driving public anger remain unresolved? Bogain and French politics editor Marc Perelman join Delano D'Souza to examine a protest movement that has evolved beyond its initial demands over purchasing power, fuel prices and education into a broader challenge to the French government. Perelman identifies a striking political paradox: Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon, despite occupying opposing ideological positions, are “objective allies” in their shared electoral interest in weakening the political centre.
links.title: French protests: 'It's only when public, private sector act together that you can make changes'

Жители Алешек, которые пожелали эвакуироваться на Украину, вылетели из аэропорта Анапы в Гомель (Белоруссия). Об этом «Ленте.ру» сообщили в Минобороны России.
Эвакуированных перевозят самолетами военно-транспортной авиации Воздушно-космических сил (ВКС) РФ. Их сопровождает уполномоченный Верховной Рады Украины по правам человека Дмитрий Лубинец.
Маршрут эвакуации опубликовало издание Fox News 28 октября. По условиям соглашения между Россией и Украиной, украинская делегация должна была вылететь из Анапы в субботу, 31 октября.

Non-secret dossiers, though, are inherently risible: call something a “dossier” in English football and you’re immediately signalling: this is absurd poindextering. Dossiers were preposterous when Don Revie was – imagine the pretension! – drawing up scouting reports on opposing players, and they are preposterous today as Mikel Arteta collates images of rival managers stepping outside their technical area. Arteta, it should be said, did not use the word “dossier”; rather it was swiftly applied to what he had called “a massive storage of images”. Germany saw particularly large rallies on Saturday, led by a youth initiative whose name roughly translates as “Gen Z has got this”. Demonstrators called for better education and healthcare, stronger climate protection and a more affordable cost of living, while also opposing any return to compulsory military service. However, protests in several major German cities turned violent towards the end of the day, particularly in the financial hub of Frankfurt. Charlotte Hughes reports on the demonstrations across Europe.

links.summary: Updates from the final day of the series at Newlands First ball in Cape Town is 10.30am local/7.30pm AEDT/8.30am GMT Any thoughts? Get in touch with an email What happened yesterday? Great question. A fine day of Test cricket, that’s what. But you want to know more. I know a guy who does match reports for The Guardian, let me hook you up. It would be unfair to say that Australia let a winning position slip on the fourth day of the third Test at Cape Town, only because that would undersell how Ryan Rickelton and Wiaan Mulder prised it away. Australia’s vaunted four bowlers, owners of 1,674 wickets at day’s beginning, could only raise that to 1,678 by day’s end. In the process, a lead of 40 became 287. South Africa had been 40 for four in the first innings at Gqeberha and bounced back to win; they were effectively 40 for four in the third innings here , and now have a great chance to do the same.

Силы ПВО сбили еще пять беспилотников ВСУ, летевших в сторону Москвы. Об этом сообщил мэр Сергей Собянин в «Максе». Всего за последние два часа вблизи столицы уничтожены 11 БПЛА.
По словам господина Собянина, на месте падения обломков дронов работают специалисты экстренных служб. Информации о возможных пострадавших или повреждениях на земле мэр не привел.
Во время атаки БПЛА приостанавливал работу аэропорт Шереметьево. Авиагавань уже вновь принимает и отправляет самолеты. Домодедово и Внуково продолжают работать по согласованию.

Число погибших в результате нападения России на юге Украины на месте, где люди собрались для получения гуманитарной помощи, выросло до 29 во вторник, при этом 48 человек все еще числятся пропавшими без вести, поскольку волна ночных ударов была нацелена на электростанции по всей стране, поврежденные больницы и раненые десятки людей.
Россия запустила 289 ударных беспилотников, 17 баллистических ракет и 59 крылатых ракет в девяти регионах, вызвав аварийные отключения электроэнергии, заявил президент Владимир Зеленский в онлайн-публикации. Эммануэль Шаз из ФРАНЦИИ 24 сообщает из Киева, Украина.

links.summary: The death toll from a Russian attack in southern Ukraine on a site where people had gathered to receive humanitarian aid rose to 29 on Tuesday, with 48 still missing, as a wave of overnight strikes targeted power plants across the country, damaged hospitals and wounded scores of people. FRANCE 24's Emmanuelle Chaze reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

b82c52928681bc4f60ca.lead_ru:
Сотрудница ЗАЭС погибла при атаке ВСУ на гражданский автомобиль
Сотрудница Запорожской атомной электростанции (ЗАЭС) погибла в результате атаки беспилотника, сообщила пресс-служба станции.

Удар пришелся по движущемуся автомобилю, в котором вместе с девушкой находился еще один человек.

Коллектив Запорожской АЭС выразил соболезнования семьям погибших. «За каждой такой потерей — семья, близкие, коллеги.

Это боль всего нашего коллектива.

Атаки на гражданские автомобили, убийства мирных людей — целенаправленный терроризм.

Люди не должны становиться мишенями», — отмечается в сообщении ЗАЭС.

bdff91033304294fc15c.lead_ru:
Лидер кенийской секты Судного дня был приговорен к 200 годам тюремного заключения за убийство 190 детей и одного взрослого в одной из худших культовых катастроф в мире в новейшей истории. Приговор, включающий 100 лет за убийство голодом и 100 лет прямым убийством, был вынесен через две недели после того, как суд в прибрежном городе Момбаса в Кении признал лидера культа виновным в преступлениях.
Прокуроры заявили, что Пол Маккензи и его международная церковь «Благая весть» руководили христианской сектой Судного дня, членам которой было приказано морить себя и своих детей голодом, чтобы попасть на небеса до того, как наступит конец света.

links.summary: Paul Mackenzie convicted over the deaths of 190 children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history. The sentence, comprised of 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa found the cult leader guilty of the crimes.

links.summary: Right in time for both Black Friday deals and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim 's 15th anniversary, you can buy the Elder Scrolls official cookbook at its lowest price we've seen it all year. You can pick one up for $17.96 at Amazon, nearly half off of its original sticker price of $35. If you wanted to get a deeper look at the book before deciding to purchase, we had the opportunity to get a sneak peek at it before it came out a few years ago. The 192-page themed cookbook is penned by Chelsea Monroe-Cassel, who has written loads of other pop culture-themed cookbooks for properties like World of Warcraft, Star Wars Galaxies Edge, Star Trek and more. This Elder Scrolls edition features food, drink, and sweet treats found throughout multiple adventures throughout Tamriel, like the sweetroll from the now-timeless meme, as well as immersive recipes inspired by the different cultures found in the game. And if you're a big Skyrim fan, the game is about to celebrate its 15th anniversary on Novembe

links.summary: Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome Efrat Shapira Rosenberg, Israeli Radio/TV Host, Columnist, Podcaster and Educator. According to Shapira, co-host of the highly popular Israeli politics podcast Miflaget Hamakshavot, the divisions are equally pronounced within the opposition bloc supporting Gadi Eisenkot.

links.summary: Is Trump losing the support of the very coalition that brought him back to power? Just one day before the midterm elections, Trump's approval rating stands at 32%, one of the lowest ever recorded at this stage of a presidency. And discontent is growing beyond Democratic voters. Some of Trump's most loyal Republican and MAGA supporters are increasingly torn between political loyalty and economic reality. The war in Iran, rising costs linked to the Strait of Hormuz blockade, unfulfilled “America First” promises and other controversial issues, including the Epstein files scandal, are widening the rift between Trump and his electoral base. Can he regain control of the diverse coalition that makes up MAGA? FRANCE 24 journalist Stella Elgersma spoke to MAGA and Republican experts to explore how the movement has evolved, what its supporters want and what is driving their discontent. Watch the full youtube documentary : https://youtu.be/XkehRG77itY?si=iOfIl0PwrgyX-j0X

20-летний приговор командира повстанцев Алиеу Косия убивал мирных жителей и безоружных солдат, а также отдавал приказы о грабежах и других преступлениях против человечности. Верховный суд Швейцарии оставил в силе 20-летний тюремный срок для бывшего командира либерийских повстанцев Алиеу Косия в пятницу, но отменил обвинительный приговор за преступления против человечности.
В 2021 году Федеральный уголовный суд Швейцарии признал Косию, которому сейчас 51 год, виновным в многочисленных зверствах, совершенных во время первой гражданской войны в Либерии, в которой в период с 1989 по 2003 год погибло около 250 000 человек.

links.summary: Classic success resulted in contract to ride at high-profile meeting for outstanding female jockey Saffie Osborne’s year began with a ride on a 150-1 chance in a race worth £7,000 at Wolverhampton on 6 January, when she trailed in last of the seven runners. Its final chapter will open on Sunday in the decidedly glitzier surroundings of Sha Tin racecourse in Hong Kong, where Osborne has 10 rides on an 11-race card, and the 10 months in between have been transformational for the 24-year-old jockey. A first top-10 finish in the Flat jockeys’ championship was the reward for Osborne’s consistency throughout the May-to-October title race, but the undoubted highlight was her victory on Highwayman victory in the St Leger in September. It was Osborne’s first Group One win, and also the first for a female jockey in a British Classic.

A competitive game that pits players against each other as they explore distinct eras from the video games, Assassin's Creed: Animus features four protagonists to choose from in its standard edition: Eivor, Ezio, Altair, and Connor. The Collector's Edition, meanwhile, expands to 10 eras and features 16 protagonists, adding game characters like Edward Kenway, Jacob and Evie Frye, and Kassandra. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rnGfEU2eXrg You and up to three of your friends (or you alone) work to complete objectives across these eras, taking down assassination targets in the way you see fit via "memory blocks." links.summary: Stripped of his WBO world title and numbed by violent deaths of friends in Battersea, the middleweight is determined to press on in pursuit of fights and titles “I’ve been very reluctant to tell my story,” Denzel Bentley says as he sits upstairs at his gym in Essex and opens up about his testing life in and out of the ring. Before he addresses the latest maddening round of boxing politics, Bentley reveals how he has dealt with genuine catastrophe and trauma. This buried pain places boxing’s shenanigans into sobering perspective because so many of his friends have been murdered on the street. Bentley has just been stripped of his WBO world middleweight title because the sanctioning body refused permission for him to defend his belt against Shane Mosley Jr this Saturday night at London’s Copper Box Arena. The body rejected his appeal last Friday that he was entitled to face the world-ranked Mosley Jr rather than his mandatory challenger in a first title defence.
links.title: ‘I’ve been chased and shot at’: Denzel Bentley on trauma, street violence and brutal boxing politics

links.summary: Fakhar Zaman scores 127 from 99 balls in Lahore Kamindu Mendis’s 131 proves in vain for Sri Lanka This mini-tournament has been a welcome change of pace, carrying more meaning than your bog-standard three-match white-ball slog between two teams. And then there’s the gift of a final to crown the winners. This was an apt conclusion under lights in front of a packed-out Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore, settled in the penultimate over as Pakistan beat Sri Lanka by three wickets to win the tri-series. Fakhar Zaman, Pakistan’s hero from the 2017 Champions Trophy final, was at the centre, crashing his way to 127 in a chase of 326. But plenty of work remained after his dismissal, and the new boys needed to stay calm. Arafat Minhas, 21, and Hasan Nawaz, 24, played it like old-timers, their partnership of 94 securing the game. Minhas and Faheem Ashraf fell with two runs still required, but Shaheen Afridi finished the evening with a wallop over the ropes.

IT-миллиардер из России получил гражданство Казахстана
Сооснователь Higgsfield Машрабов стал гражданином Казахстана
Сооснователь ИИ-платформы Higgsfield Александр Машрабов получил гражданство Казахстана.

Указ подписал президент республики Касым-Жомарт Токаев.

Об этом сообщил в Facebook (принадлежит Meta, которая признана экстремистской и запрещена в РФ) министр искусственного интеллекта и цифрового развития Казахстана Жаслан Мадиев.

Министр лично вручил бизнесмену паспорт гражданина страны.

По законодательству Казахстана, двойное гражданство запрещено, поэтому господин Машрабов обязан отказаться от паспорта другой страны.

links.summary: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, divisions within the MAGA camp are becoming increasingly visible. From the war in Iran and rising fuel prices to the Epstein files, several of Trump’s decisions are fuelling divisions among his most loyal supporters. Once united by a shared vision of America, MAGA now brings together factions that increasingly disagree over foreign policy, the economy and what “America First” should actually mean. Today, we saw there is still more to do to get to this level. Even sometimes in this match we were close to achieving it. We had chances, but we must be ruthless in the final third. Three-nil maybe was more than we deserved.”

It’s essentially an 'upgraded' version of the N7 replica helmet that launched alongside Mass Effect Legendary Edition back in 2020, adding a layer of padding as well as a weathered finish to reflect how the helmet appears in-game. links.summary: Saturday is set to see another day of nationwide demonstrations over the cost of living and conditions in schools. But France’s highest administrative court has just upheld a ban on the planned route of the Paris march, forcing protesters to remain on the eastern outskirts of the capital. Authorities are deploying 70,000 security personnel and imposing curfews in some areas, repeating many of the measures seen last weekend. The interior minister has also issued a Halloween-themed warning: covering your face at a demonstration remains illegal. Ophelie Jacobson reports.

links.summary: Police homicide division opens judicial proceedings He was struck in the chest when challenging for ball Spanish football was in shock on Tuesday after the Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel died after a collision with the Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono during a match in the second division. The homicide division of the national police has opened judicial proceedings into a possible involuntary manslaughter, a routine procedure after any death not by natural causes. The chief public prosecutor in Santa Cruz de Tenerife told the state news agency EFE that it was “very difficult” for a case to come to court. Tenerife announced that De Miguel had died at 8am on Tuesday after he had been taken into intensive care on Monday afternoon. He did not regain consciousness after a cardiorespiratory arrest.

Двое погибших после аварий автобусов во Франции, сообщают чиновники. Молодая девушка и 18-летний мужчина погибли после того, как автобус разбился на востоке Франции, сообщили местные власти. Автобус ехал между Лионом и Бур-ан-Брессом, когда он разбился около 07:00 по местному времени в пятницу в городе Великий пост, примерно в 34 милях (55 км) от границы со Швейцарией.
В автобусе находились 43 пассажира, в том числе 15 детей, сообщила прокуратура Бур-ан-Бресса. Три человека находятся в критическом состоянии, по меньшей мере 13 человек получили легкие травмы.

Путин пригласил на чаепитие в Кремль детей погибших участников спецоперации
Президент России Владимир Путин пригласил на чаепитие в Кремль детей участников специальной военной операции, погибших при выполнении боевых задач, а также их матерей. Об этом сообщил Кремль.
«Эта встреча в Кремле проходит сейчас», – сказал пресс-секретарь президента РФ Дмитрий Песков.
На встрече также присутствует заместитель министра обороны РФ, председатель фонда «Защитники Отечества» Анна Цивилева.
Ранее в честь Дня народного единства Путин пообщался с детьми участников спецоперации и волонтерами на Красной площади.

Президент Польши Кароль Навроцкий созвал срочное совещание с председателем Конституционного суда и другими судьями на фоне попытки государственного переворота. Об этом сообщает Telewizja Republika.
Вечером 30 октября вокруг здания КС начались беспорядки. Толпа протестующих окружила трибунал, полиция заняла оборону на территории здания, заблокировав его. В связи с ситуацией Навроцкий прервал визит в Сенегал и срочно вылетел на родину.
Позднее стало известно, что польская полиция готовится к возможному применению силы у здания КС.

Глава ЛНР Пасечник сообщил об атаке на здание Луганской телефонной компании
Ночью 21 октября ВСУ нанесли массированный удар по центру Луганска. При атаке повреждено здание Луганской телефонной компании (ЛТК). Об этом сообщил глава ЛНР Леонид Пасечник в Telegram-канале.
По словам господина Пасечника, во время атаки в здании находилась дежурная смена специалистов, часть из них успела выйти. Под завалами еще могут находиться люди. В ликвидации последствий задействованы необходимые службы и местные власти, рассказал губернатор.
Как уточнили в региональном МЧС, после удара в здании ЛТК начался пожар. Огонь распространился на все 10 этажей.

links.summary: France is bracing for a third consecutive weekend of protests, with around 70,000 security personnel deployed to prevent a repeat of the violence seen on October 17. Shops have boarded up their premises as authorities warn of further clashes, with Halloween celebrations adding to security concerns over masked demonstrators. The protests, involving Yellow Vest activists, trade unions and students, initially focused on the rising cost of living, inequality and poor school conditions, but have since expanded to include demands for greater civil liberties and the right to protest. The demonstrations come six months ahead of presidential elections, amid a tense political climate and growing support for the far right. Authorities have restricted marches in several cities, while Paris police have only authorised a demonstration on the capital's outskirts. Curfews have also been imposed in parts of Paris as officials seek to prevent further unrest.
links.title: France's Nunez warns of high risk during protests

f99ee123095f670db807.lead_ru:
Явка на выборах в Израиле побила 45-летний рекорд
К 10:00 по местному времени (11:00 мск) на парламентских выборах в Израиле приняли участие 16,68% избирателей (более 1,2 млн человек). Для страны это рекордный показатель за последние 45 лет, сообщает газета «Едиот Ахронот» со ссылкой на Центральный избирательный комитет Израиля.
По мнению экспертов, высокая явка обусловлена тем, что это первые выборы в стране со времени нападения на Израиль группировки ХАМАС 7 октября 2023 года. Как утверждают аналитики, многие избиратели рассматривают выборы как возможность выразить свое отношение к действиям правительства во время нападения и после него.

fb31cb6cf401cdaa78e9.lead_ru:
Бывший канцлер Германии Ангела Меркель предложила сделать следующим президентом Германии женщину. Ее слова приводит Spiegel.
Меркель заявила, что знает женщин, которые могли бы занять этот пост, но конкретные имена называть не стала. По ее словам, за 77 лет истории Федеративной Республики Германия еще ни разу федеральным президентом не была женщина.
«Теперь стоит задуматься, не пришло ли для этого время», — заключила она.
Ранее президент Германии Франк-Вальтер Штайнмайер заявил о риске разделения страны по типу Веймарской республики, которая появилась в результате ноябрьской революции и просуществовала с 1918 года по 1933 год.

Двое погибших после аварий автобусов во Франции, сообщают чиновники. Молодая девушка и 18-летний мужчина погибли после того, как автобус разбился на востоке Франции, сообщили местные власти. Мертвые дельфины, морские мины: российско-украинская война опустошает Черное море. Война России на Украине наносит сокрушительный удар по морской жизни Черного моря, убивая более 120 000 дельфинов и причиняя экологический ущерб. Почему США, Россия и Китай спешат разместить ядерные реакторы на Луне? Лунные реакторы могут произвести революцию в освоении Луны, обеспечивая энергию для баз и добычи полезных ископаемых, но риски загрязнения остаются. Соединенные Штаты, Россия и Китай спешат построить ядерные реакторы на Луне, поскольку ученые предупреждают о возможном риске радиоактивного несчастного случая.
В январе космическое агентство США NASA объявило о планах разработать ядерный реактор на Луне к концу 2030 года. Россия, работая с Китаем, стремится сделать то же самое к 2036 году, поскольку они стремятся продвигать освоение космоса.
